aboutGame.title: What is Void Platform?
paragraphs: Void Platform is a browser-based precision platformer built around wall jumps, dashes, and carefully timed movement across floating platforms. Each level asks you to read a jump, commit to an arc, and recover quickly when a route collapses into spikes or open void.

The core loop is simple: clear gaps, avoid spike hazards, and collect coins while pushing toward the next checkpoint. Our guides break down controls, movement timing, falling mechanics, and survival strategies so new players can turn repeated attempts into consistent clears.

modules.name: Void Platform Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the first-run loop in Void Platform: read the level, time your jump, use the dash, and reach the next checkpoint without wasting attempts.

highlights.detail: Start with a short run and test jump height and dash distance before committing to a gap.
Watch each platform for one full cycle so you know when it dwells and when it moves.
Use wall jumps to regain height and dash to cross gaps that a normal jump cannot clear.
Land near the center of moving platforms; edges are where momentum carries you into the void.
Treat spikes and open pits as reset points and learn the respawn anchor before pushing ahead.

modules.name: Void Platform Gameplay Guide
modules.description: Understand the core Void Platform loop: traverse floating platforms, collect coins, avoid spike hazards, and keep a clean route from start to checkpoint.

highlights.label: Movement
highlights.detail: Chain jumps, wall jumps, and dashes to cross floating platforms.

highlights.label: Coins
highlights.detail: Collect coins along the route while keeping enough time to line up the next jump.

highlights.label: Spikes
highlights.detail: Treat spike beds as lethal hazards and approach their edges at low speed.

highlights.label: Anchors
highlights.detail: Learn respawn anchors so a failed route costs one attempt, not the whole run.

highlights.label: Routes
highlights.detail: Watch a platform's full cycle before boarding so you commit on the dwell.

modules.name: Void Platform Tips and Tricks
modules.description: Practical Void Platform tips for cleaner jumps, safer platform boarding, and faster recovery after a missed route.

highlights.label: Coyote
highlights.detail: A late jump still registers briefly after you leave a ledge, so do not panic-spam.

highlights.label: Buffer
highlights.detail: Press jump just before landing to queue the next hop on contact.

highlights.label: Apex
highlights.detail: Change direction near the top of the arc, where air control is strongest.

highlights.label: Dwell
highlights.detail: Board moving platforms during their pause instead of as they accelerate.

highlights.label: Reset
highlights.detail: Use a deliberate void reset to return to the last anchor after a bad route.

modules.name: Void Platform Progression Guide
modules.description: Plan the climb from your first clean clear to harder Void Platform routes by learning anchors, movement tech, and repeatable lines.

highlights.detail: Clear the opening route without dashing so you learn the natural jump spacing.
Add a dash after a wall jump to extend a gap without overshooting the landing.
Practice anchor routing on a known checkpoint until the reset becomes automatic.
Revisit earlier levels for cleaner lines and coin routes instead of forcing new ground.
Chain movement tech into one continuous run once each jump is reliable on its own.

items.question: What is Void Platform?
items.answer: Void Platform is a browser-based precision platformer built around wall jumps, dashes, spike hazards, and coin collection. Each run asks you to read a platform pattern, commit to a jump, and recover quickly after a missed route.

items.question: Does Void Platform require a download?
items.answer: Void Platform runs in a browser, so you can start a run without installing a separate client. Open the game page and use the movement and jump controls to begin.

items.question: What controls does Void Platform use?
items.answer: Void Platform uses horizontal movement, jump, wall jump, and dash. Jump timing matters more than speed: hold for a higher arc, release early for short hops, and dash only after you have lined up the landing.

items.question: Why does my jump in Void Platform keep failing?
items.answer: Most failed Void Platform jumps come from boarding a moving platform too late, correcting too late in the fall, or releasing direction after the apex. Watch one full platform cycle, commit at the dwell, and steer near the top of the arc.

items.question: How do I survive longer in Void Platform?
items.answer: Treat spikes and open void as reset points, land near the center of moving platforms, and learn the spacing between respawn anchors. A deliberate reset is faster than forcing a bad route.
